editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: WhiskeySockets/Baileys
items.summary: Baileys offers a socket-based interface (API) that is based on the WhatsApp Web protocol and allows developing TypeScript and JavaScript-based applications. Thanks to this library, developers can directly integrate WhatsApp messaging functions into their own projects.

items.title: agavra/tuicr
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, tuicr is a terminal user interface-based code review tool that supports Vim keyboard shortcuts. It allows developers to manage their code review process directly from the terminal.

items.title: UEFA and its national associations will not participate in FIFA competitions
items.summary: UEFA and its member national associations announced that they will not participate in the new tournament formats planned by FIFA. This decision reflects differences of opinion regarding the management and organizational structure of the international football calendar.

items.title: Read this before you buy that TV streaming stick
items.summary: Television streaming sticks pose risks of malware and unauthorized data tracking that compromise the security of the devices. Users should review the privacy policies and software updates of the devices, especially when choosing hardware offered by unknown brands.

items.title: Stacked PRs are now live on GitHub
items.summary: GitHub has opened the stacked pull requests feature to public preview to speed up software development processes. This feature allows developers to ship large changes in smaller, manageable pieces, linked together.

items.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT‑5.6
items.summary: OpenAI aims to reduce transaction costs by expanding the price-performance limit with its new generation language model GPT-5.6. The model optimizes computation costs in complex tasks with architectural improvements that offer higher efficiency.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
items.summary: Gemini Robotics 2, developed by Google DeepMind, enables robots to manage their physical movements and environmental perceptions with integrated intelligence (whole body intelligence). This model allows robots to perform complex tasks with greater precision and adaptability.

items.title: owensong/Inflect-Micro-v2
items.summary: Inflect-Micro-v2 is a compact artificial intelligence model developed for text-to-speech operations. It focuses on fast speech synthesis processes with low resource consumption.

glossary.explanation: A digital bridge that allows two different software to exchange data with each other.
